Arrange the following states in descending order of their total population as per Census 2011:

(A) Bihar
(B) Uttar Pradesh
(C) Maharashtra
(D) West Bengal

Choose the correct sequence from the options given below:

options.text: C, B, A, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: B, C, A, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: B, A, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: D, C, A, B
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
1. Uttar Pradesh is 1st (199.8 million) (B).
2. Maharashtra is 2nd (112.4 million) (C).
3. Bihar is 3rd (104.1 million) (A).
4. West Bengal is 4th (91.3 million) (D).
Hence, Option B is correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.

questionText: Which of the following statements regarding Population Growth in People (World Population and Human Development) is INCORRECT / NOT true?

options.text: It conforms strictly to the standard equilibrium conditions defined in NCERT People (World Population and Human Development).

options.text: Its magnitude depends directly on the governing physical or analytical constants of Population Growth.
